statistical_method.confirmation_alpha_spending: alpha_i = budget / ((i+1)*(i+2)) across all fresh candidate confirmation attempts; total spend is at most 0.025.
statistical_method.confirmation_rule: Promote only when a fresh sample's one-sided exact binomial lower bound is strictly above target. Cumulative results are descriptive.
statistical_method.interpretation: Match outcomes are conditional on the persisted opponent pools and assume independently seeded Bernoulli matches. Wilson intervals are descriptive; promotion uses an exact binomial bound on new confirmation matches.
